messages:
alexa: Heads-up: new "security-patch" lane + telemetry ramp for this week's train. Short summary below — please ack.

deploy-bot: Freeze window for this train: Sun 01:00-04:00 UTC. Tag `security-patch` enabled.

paul (release-manager): Security-patch lane is intended for vetted CVE/backport fixes that are backward-compatible. Flow: `/patch-fastlane --svc <svc> --cve <CVE-ID> --owner @you` will open a triage ticket to security+RM with 15m SLA.

yasmin (security): Quick clarifier: fastlane only for fixes that do not require schema migrations or client changes. If KMS perms changed, we will require full review. Fastlane approvals are auditable and attach token.

mina (sre): Telemetry ramping: for any security-patch deploy we'll automatically enable enhanced traces and double the sampling for 60m post-deploy. Synthetic probes run every 90s for the first 10m, then 3m for the remainder.

carl (eng): If a patch touches model-serving code (not the model binary), does it go through fastlane or normal canary?

yasmin (security): Code-only fixes that don't swap model artifacts can use fastlane. If they affect inference path or key caching, SRE may require a short 10m smoke canary. Mention `--impact inference` in the CLI.

paul (release-manager): Example CLI (copyable):
```bash
/patch-fastlane --svc inference-api --cve CVE-2026-1234 --owner @carl --reason "sandbox bypass fix" --impact inference
```

jo (prodops): Ops note: post-patch checklist will auto-run: health-checks, p99 latency compare, and a small traffic shadow test to ensure no behavioral changes. If any check fails we rollback.

alexa: We'll add a 1-line bullet to the weekly release broadcast: "Security-patch fastlane (15m triage), telemetry ramp for 60m, synthetic probes every 90s -> 3m, fastlane disallows KMS permission changes."

paul (release-manager): Audit token created: patch-fastlane-2105550000. Link will be in the handbook entry.

carl (eng): acked. I'll prepare the patch PR with the `--impact` flag and attach the small smoke test.

mina (sre): Also: for any fastlane we enable a temporary 48h log retention for the service and pin the canary dashboard to the RM channel. Use `--observe <dash-id>` to link it.

yasmin (security): Security will publish a short FAQ in the handbook with examples of allowed/disallowed changes. ETA EOD.

alexa: Thanks all — please reply with ack if you saw this. We'll lock the policy tomorrow after 24h unless blockers show up. :lock:
file_description: announcement about a security-patch fastlane, telemetry ramping, and post-patch ops for the release train
